newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-MLS NEW ENGLAND CLUB LANDS PORTUGUESE LEAGUE STRIKER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MLS NEW ENGLAND CLUB LANDS PORTUGUESE LEAGUE STRIKER.

text.p: The New England Revolution added offensive firepower to its lineup Thursday when the Major League Soccer club acquired striker Chiquinho Conde from Vitoria de Setubal of the Portuguese first division.
The 31-year old Conde, a native of Mozambique, is currently playing as captain of his national team in World Cup qualifying matches in the African region.
Before playing for Vitoria de Setubal, for which he has scored seven goals this season, Conde starred for the Potuguese first division powerhouse Sporting Lisbon.
Conde is expected to join the Revolution during pre-season training camp in Florida in early March and will receive a very warm welcome from new England coach Thomas Rongen.
"We are extremely excited to acquire a player of Chiquinho's talent and experience," a delighted Rongen said in a statement issued by the team.
"He is a proven goal scorer in an extremely competitive league and has tremendous international experience," Rongen said.
"He has versatility to play up top or out wide and will give us a leadership presence on and off the field."
